The following is a list of all of the home video releases of the Pokémon animation available for purchase on digital platforms such as the [[iTunes Store]], [[Google Play]], and [[Prime Video]] (this page does not list releases available for streaming on platforms such as [[Netflix]] or [[Hulu]]). Most releases are available in the United States, {{pmin|Canada}}, {{pmin|Australia}}, and {{pmin|the United Kingdom}}. It contains the [[Pokémon animated series]], [[Pokémon Origins]] as well as the {{pkmn|movie}}s. All releases have English closed captions available. ==[[Original series|Pokémon the Series: The Beginning]]== Unlike previous releases of the first season, the videos used for this release have been remastered and are available in HD. They are also used on the {{DL|Pokémon in the United States|Disney XD|DisneyNOW}} service and on Blu-ray releases. The [[Kanto Pokérap]] is included, but the [[Who's That Pokémon?]] segments are not. The first season is available for purchase in the following languages and territories: * iTunes: English (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia) * Amazon Video: English (United States, United Kingdom; except [[EP051]]) * Google TV/YouTube: English (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia) The second season is available for purchase in the following languages and territories: * English (United States) The second season can be streamed with a Pokémon on Amazon subscription in the following languages and territories: * English (United States, United Kingdom) {| class="roundtable" style="margin:0.5em auto 0 auto; text-align:center; background:#{{colorschemelight|Kanto}}; border:3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Kanto}}" !
